The '''Marauder's Stronghold''' was a fortified camp on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest moon of]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. It was used as the headquarters and stronghold of the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The camp was mostly made of salvaged parts of crashed starships.<ref name="SWG:MS" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[King/Legends|King]] [[Terak]], the leader of the Sanyassan Marauders, resided in the Marauder's Stronghold. Other inhabitants included the [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] [[Szingo]], the fightmaster [[Jorak]] and the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Charal]].<ref name="SWG:MTP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Marauder Theme Park}}</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a number of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] visited the stronghold to offer their services to the Marauders.<ref name="SWG:MTP" />

[[File:Marauder_stronghold_2.jpg|250px|thumb|Marauder's Stronghold]]

==Behind the scenes==
The Marauder's Stronghold was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
